convert_eqv2_to_hydra: run the eqv2_to_hydra_eqv2 script to convert an equiv2 checkpoint and yaml config to hydra format
run_eqv2_conversion_cli: run the python cli with eqv2 checkpoint and yaml paths to output hydra formatted checkpoint and config
convert_checkpoint_and_config_to_hydra: call convert_checkpoint_and_config_to_hydra to transform an eqv2 checkpoint and yaml into hydra equivalents
migrate_eqv2_config_to_hydra: migrate an existing eqv2 yaml config and checkpoint to hydra format using the conversion script
generate_hydra_eqv2_artifacts: generate hydra-compatible eqv2 checkpoint and yaml files from original eqv2 artifacts via the cli
